_comment: Quests. Each has stages in order; a stage is finished by talking to someone (an 'advance' choice in content/people/people.json, which takes the stage's needs from the bag) or by a world flag (done_when). target points the HUD: 'person:<id>', 'ruin', 'spot:<village spot>', or ''. Names are placeholders.

stages.text: Go into the echo ruin south of the plaza, and wake what sleeps there.
Tell Elder Teshwa what happened in the ruin.
Bring Maru 4 raw meat. Redstriders graze the grass around the village.
Bring Dael 8 flint. Flint nodules lie on rocky ground; gather them with E.
Set a Tether on the carved plinth at the old steading, beyond the wall to the south-east. A Tether stone takes 16 rust rock and 2 flint, and you must know a word of Avarra to make one.
Tell Dael the steading has a Tether again.
Bring Mimmie-L'ou 3 fresh redroot and 2 vermillion reed stalks. Redroot grows wild in meadows; vermillion reeds grow along the water.
Ask Archivist Ilen, in the college library, what a 'tomato' is.
Find a real tomato where the veil fails and Earth breaks through (an Occlusion), and bring it to Mimmie-L'ou.
